above_threshold: strictly greater than $655 per day: separately payable under the applicable CMS methodology
at_or_below_threshold: $655 per day or less: packaged into the nuclear medicine test payment
threshold_metric: CMS-estimated per-day cost for a product HCPCS code; not a dose invoice price
payment_method_with_claims: arithmetic mean unit cost (MUC) derived from hospital claims
coverage_limit: Payment classification does not establish coverage, a future FAPI-74 price, or eligibility for any particular patient.
